subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should the existing admin-scoped `configPath` snapshot field be shown in the Overview snapshot card, moved to a Settings/config information area, or left to CLI/status surfaces only?
rationale: The code change is small, but the linked request is a UI placement decision for an absolute local path and the issue already carries a product-decision signal.

options.title: Accept Overview Placement
options.body: After proof and conflict refresh, land the narrow display-only row that uses the existing admin-scoped snapshot field.

options.title: Move To Settings
options.body: Ask for the same existing field to be surfaced in a Settings/config information area instead of the Overview snapshot card.

options.title: Keep CLI/Status Only
options.body: Decline a new Control UI exposure point and leave active config-path discovery to the existing command/status surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Placement
recommendation.body: After proof and conflict refresh, land the narrow display-only row that uses the existing admin-scoped snapshot field.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest Overview view feature-history signal for the UI surface receiving the visible row.
